summary: commonweb-flow pulls install-scripted dependency from off-registry host
details: package.json declares a dependency `linker-event-header-serial` pinned to a direct tarball URL at `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/linker-event-header-serial` rather than the npm registry. npm-shrinkwrap.json records `hasInstallScript: true` for that dependency, so `npm install commonweb-flow` fetches an unpinned, non-integrity-verified tarball from an unrelated third-party host and executes its install lifecycle on the installer's machine. The shipped index.js only re-exports name/version and the package.json metadata is placeholder (`description: Generated package`, `author: Package Registry`, `github.com/example/...`) — the package is a thin wrapper whose sole install-time effect is resolving and running attacker-controlled bytes from yosiroute.com.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
